name: Sports Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Sports Mahjong is a free Mahjong game. Finally a game of mahjong for jocks! If you've always been more of a sports head and less of a strategy-type person then we think we've found a game for you: Sports Mahjong! Take a look at all of these cool mahjong tiles all based on Olympic sports like archery, the javelin, weightlifting, and whatever. All that stuff, all the stuff you've heard about on T.V or had to do in gym class, it's all here, and now it's in mahjong form. Mahjong is a classic strategy game that has been around for hundreds of years. It is something that comes standard on most PC's ad can be found in most retirement homes. It is a fun and fulfilling game of tactics and pattern recognition.
